footnote_text: On October 15, 2026, Medtronic plc ("Medtronic") completed an exchange offer pursuant to which Medtronic disposed of 252,813,348 shares of common stock of MiniMed Group, Inc. ("Common Stock") in exchange for 55,032,401 ordinary shares of Medtronic. Following completion of the exchange offer, Medtronic no longer owns any shares of Common Stock.
